text:
incident-bot: PAGER: oncall-sre — multiple 5xx/error spikes from services in eu-central-1, starting ~2187654300. Alerts: egress timeouts, failed webhook deliveries, customer SDK errors. Paging now.

maya.patel: seeing a big uptick in NAT error counts and connection resets for subnets in az-b. Customers reporting >50% failed outbound requests.

ev an.chen: (typo) evan.chen: I'm on it, grabbing VPC logs. Any recent infra change in eu-central-1?

samir.khan: terraform apply for route changes landed ~2187654200 from infra-ci. I see a change in route-table rt-0c5 -> default route was updated.

maya.patel: can you paste the diff?

samir.khan: here's the snippet from the plan output we rolled:

```
- route 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-gw-0a1 (old)
+ route 0.0.0.0/0 -> eni-attach-0b3 (new, internal nat instance)
```

samir.khan: that ENI is attached to a bastion-type instance with source/dest check enabled -> likely dropping return traffic across AZs.

priya.nair: that's bad — we have asymmetric routing. Health checks for most services in az-b started failing at 2187654310.

alex.li: confirmed from VPC flow logs: many SYN packets to 1.2.3.4 (external) and then RST or no reply. Return traffic showing via different AZ.

ev an.chen: rolling back the Terraform change now. tagging @deploy-bot to trigger revert.

deploy-bot: Revert pipeline triggered for commit c7f9a2, starting rollback at 2187654380.

maya.patel: meanwhile customers still impacted — can we put a quick mitigation? Create a managed NAT gateway and point rt assoc for affected private subnets back to nat-gw?

samir.khan: creating a new NAT gateway in az-b will take ~2-3m to allocate elastic ip and become available. I'll start that now.

```
# commands run by samir
aws ec2 create-nat-gateway --subnet-id subnet-0b --allocation-id eipalloc-07
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0c5 --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id nat-0f2
```

samir.khan: NAT creation started 2187654405.

infra-bot: Route table rtb-0c5 now points 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0f2 (nat-gateway) as of 2187654438.

priya.nair: traffic recovery starting. Error rate dropping for a subset of customers. Latency back to normal for az-b services that use rtb-0c5.

ev an.chen: rollback complete — Terraform revert applied at 2187654460 (commit c7f9a2 reverted).

maya.patel: checklist: 1) rollback confirmed 2) nat-gateway created for immediate mitigation 3) enforcement: block future route replacements that point to ENI/instances without src/dst check false.

samir.khan: adding a policy to infra-ci to forbid `route -> eni-*` for default 0.0.0.0/0 unless it's a documented NAT instance with src/dst check disabled. Putting a lint blocker now.

alex.li: customer incident classification: partial outage for eu-central-1 private egress. Impact window ~2187654300 - 2187654440 (~2.3m). Some customers saw transient failures longer due to retries.

maya.patel: notifying CS and statuspage. Drafting message: "We experienced partial egress failures in eu-central-1 due to an incorrect route update. Mitigated by revert and temporary NAT gateway. No data loss. Full postmortem to follow."

priya.nair: on-call handoff — I'm going to stay on the thread for 30m for verification, then hand off to evan.chen at 2187654800 if no regressions.

evan.chen: ack. I'll monitor metrics and VPC flow logs, watching for route flips and NAT error counters.

maya.patel: root-cause notes for now: manual/CI change replaced default route with ENI attached to instance that had src/dst check on -> asymmetric return path -> dropped traffic. Contributing factor: no infra-ci lint rule preventing ENI routes and no automated runbook to failover NAT per-AZ.

samir.khan: immediate actions: (1) block ENI as target for 0.0.0.0/0 in infra policy (2) add pre-apply check to detect route target changes across multiple AZs (3) add post-deploy synthetic egress test for private subnets.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: acknowledged and set status to mitigated at 2187654450.

maya.patel: thanks everyone. I'll create the incident ticket and assign owners. Please add notes to the ticket with timestamps and commands.

alex.li: added brief to statuspage at 2187654550. CS notified and responding to customer follow-ups.

priya.nair: handing off monitoring to evan.chen now. I'm online but stepping back.

ev an.chen: taking over monitoring. will escalate to oncall-sre-manager if we see new fluctuation.

samir.khan: follow-up: I pushed a quick patch to infra-ci linter (rule id: no-eni-default-route) in PR #482 — will require review but disabling manual apply temporarily for default routes until merge.

maya.patel: good. add to postmortem: timeline, Terraform diff, mitigations, customer impact, and long-term fixes (policy + per-AZ nat autoscale).

incident-bot: Remind: create postmortem within 48h and link to this thread.

maya.patel: copying notes into the ticket now and will ping owners for drafts. Closing thread for now, we will reopen if new alerts. :white_check_mark:
